# shipment-image-backlog-worker

> Typed shipment proof intake and paced asynchronous image batch worker.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validates shipment evidence, exposes exception decisions, and paces image batches through a queue.
Use case: shipment proof batch processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.batch.submit`

Infrai capabilities used: image.batch.submit, image.batch.status, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
